<compartment start="79" end="94" title="Auditable proration credit ledger" episode_type="design,feature,release" importance="86">
<p1>
U: "credits are money; don't hide them in metadata"

Built Billetto's proration credit flow around real ledger entries instead of Stripe invoice metadata. The new billing/src/credits/proration.ts calculates unused-time and downgrade credits against subscription_version, then writes account_credit_entries tied to invoice_line_id. U: "we need ledger lines you can audit in six months"

Retries reuse the same idempotency key and detect existing ledger entries instead of minting another credit. Added migration 202605101422_add_account_credit_entries.sql, rollback dry-run fixtures, and a release check that compares Stripe invoice totals against the local ledger. Commit 6c2d8ef.
</p1>
<p2>
Billetto proration credits are ledger entries because U: "credits are money; don't hide them in metadata". account_credit_entries ties credits to invoice_line_id and subscription_version for auditable retries.
</p2>
<p3>
Billetto made proration credits auditable by storing them in its own ledger table rather than Stripe metadata.
</p3>

<compartment start="15" end="22" title="Stopped contrastive loss cliff" episode_type="investigation,bug" importance="82">
<p1>
U: "can you chase the loss cliff, not tune around it"

Investigated Nereid's contrastive trainer after loss jumped from 0.42 to 3.8 around step 17.8k on A100 runs. The tempting path was LR tuning, but crop-hash logging showed duplicated augmentations across dataloader workers after worker_init_fn was dropped in 6fb2d90. Restored per-worker seeding in training/data/seed.py, added epoch_seed to the run manifest, and reran runs/2026-05-08/a100-bf16-rerun through 52k steps without the cliff. Commit c8e4a11.
</p1>
<p2>
Nereid's loss cliff was caused by shared augmentation seeds across dataloader workers, not optimizer settings. training/data/seed.py now derives worker seeds from base seed, worker id, and epoch.
</p2>
<p3>
Nereid contrastive training stabilized after restoring per-worker augmentation seeds.
</p3>
<p4>worker_init_fn; augmentation_seed; runs/2026-05-08/a100-bf16-rerun</p4>
</compartment>

</CONSTRAINTS>

<compartment start="17" end="55" title="B 实施重启：回收侦察、直读 A 基础、派发 M1/M2 子道" episode_type="investigation,feature,infra" importance="62">
<p1>
exp-3（数据/架构不变量）后台任务回收，关键结论定案：成员授权撤销 = T02 `status active→revoked` + `revoked_at`（置位非删除、非 revision）；旧请求重放只定位旧 grant 返回 `GRANT_REVOKED`；重新授权须新人脸请求→新行新 grantId，`uq_grant_active` 部分唯一保证同 (account,member) 仅一条 active。绑定 = T03 行锁串行、`binding_revision` 仅真实绑/解绑递增、他人已绑→`BOUND_TO_OTHER`、代次不符→`BINDING_CHANGED`(409)、解绑须原账号 + `If-Match: binding-{revision}`。云台只见 `current_assessment_id` 指向的当前任务，恢复/轮询/旧重试不递增 `current_assessment_revision`，Worker 永不改指针。通知 = T10 创建时快照 account/binding/destination 路由代次，投递前锁外核实会话 + 短事务按 T03→T09→T10→T12 重检，不符即 cancelled；submitted≠delivered，崩溃后 unknown 走对账。成员可靠建档归 D（B 只读 T01）；推送/SMS/会话/人脸/OSS 提供方均未选定 → 明确替身 + 生产 fail-closed。

我自行核验 14 表 schema 的地面事实：`gimbals` 无 `observation_epoch/observation_seq` 列 → M2 云台心跳的 epoch/seq 必须存进 `gimbals.latest_observation` JSONB（F 形态、写时带 schema_version），从而不需要公共迁移、不碰共享 Schema；`member_access_grants.source_request_id` NOT NULL UNIQUE → 建授权必须先有 T13 行，M1-A01 必须走 A 的 IdempotencyService；`notifications.account_id` NOT NULL、`payload` 强制 schema_version、`uq_notification_dedup` 含 cancelled 行（不得靠删行重置去重键）；`notification_destinations` active ⇒ account_id+session_ref+registration 非空（DB CHECK 已强制）；stub 中属 B 的端点已逐条定位（M1×3、M2×7、M5×1），M2-A01 云台认证在 A 的 auth 控制器内接线，可方法级精准移除。

U: 用户重启后已明确"继续"——仍只在mvp-b业务树，运行文件放本树忽略的 .coordination/B-work/，不读根协调目录或服务凭据；为控制内存，只在实际测试需要时启动B专属PG55435/Web18083/worker18084，保留mvp-b-pg卷；不使用A默认55432、不启动A/E或其他包服务；原12API/统一MediaAccessPolicy边界、共享改动先报协调、真实Oracle最终SHA门禁、仅feature提交不合并推送均不变。

恢复后先查后台任务状态：Map A foundation code for B 上次已被 RequestBurstTooFast 限流打断，重试后再次触发平台突发保护失败（[47] task error，RequestBurstTooFast）。不再依赖该子任务，改为自行直读 A 基础代码完成集成映射（认证端口/PrincipalContext、MediaAccessPolicy 现状、IdempotencyService/T13 模式、worker handler 调用协议、stub 端点位置），随后完成 L1 公共接线类编辑（统一业务 MediaAccessPolicy 落位 web/mediapolicy、B 相关 stub 占位移除），并在收尾派发 L2「Implement M1 identity APIs」、L3「Implement M2 device APIs」两条实施子道（M5+handler 的 L4 待后续派发，L5 验收脚本仍按计划）。feature/mvp-identity-devices 基线 ccee6e28、门禁纪律均未变。
</p1>
<p2>
回收 exp-3 侦察定案：撤销=置位非删（active→revoked + revoked_at，重放→GRANT_REVOKED）、绑定=T03 行锁 + revision 串行（BOUND_TO_OTHER/BINDING_CHANGED）、通知=创建时路由快照 + 投递前 T03→T09→T10→T12 重检、成员建档归 D、各提供方未选→替身+fail-closed。
自核 schema：gimbals 无 epoch/seq 列 → 心跳 epoch/seq 存 latest_observation JSONB（免公共迁移）；source_request_id NOT NULL UNIQUE → M1-A01 必须先建 T13、必须走 IdempotencyService；uq_notification_dedup 含 cancelled 行不可删行重置；notification_destinations active 三字段非空由 DB CHECK 强制；stub 端点 M1×3/M2×7/M5×1 已定位。
U: "仍只在mvp-b业务树…为控制内存，只在实际测试需要时启动B专属PG55435/Web18083/worker18084，保留mvp-b-pg卷…"
Map A foundation 子任务二次 RequestBurstTooFast 失败，放弃该后台道、自行直读 A 代码完成基础映射，做 L1 公共接线编辑（MediaAccessPolicy/stub 移除），派发 Implement M1 identity APIs 与 Implement M2 device APIs 两条实施子道。
</p2>
<p3>
B 实施重启完成：exp-3 侦察定稿、schema 地面事实自核定案（gimbals 心跳 epoch/seq 走 latest_observation JSONB 免迁移、source_request_id UNIQUE 强制 M1-A01 经 IdempotencyService）。A 基础映射子任务两次 RequestBurstTooFast 限流后改为自行直读完成；完成 L1 公共接线并在最后派发 M1/M2 实现子道，进入正式实施。
</p3>
<p4>
B 重启实施；RequestBurstTooFast×2→自行直读 A 基础；gimbals latest_observation JSONB 承载心跳 epoch/seq；source_request_id UNIQUE→走 IdempotencyService
